project_type: Python CLI tool for syncing Yandex Music favorites and converting to ALAC
test_framework: Manual verification (no test suite required for this greenfield CLI tool)
verification_instructions: 1. pip install -e . succeeds without errors. 2. python -m ym_sync --help shows usage. 3. Code imports resolve correctly.
environment_constraints: Python 3.9.25 available (not 3.11 as initially stated). ffmpeg is NOT installed - the tool should gracefully handle missing ffmpeg at runtime. Network is OPEN_INTERNET so pip install works.
key_patterns: Reference code at /projects/sandbox/ymd-ref/ provides patterns for: API auth (core.init_client), fetching favorites (client.users_likes_tracks()), downloading tracks (api.get_download_info + api.download_track), tagging (core.set_tags with mutagen), path building. The CLI tool vendors the needed download/decrypt logic from the reference.
directory_structure: Target structure: /projects/sandbox/qwerf/ with pyproject.toml, README.md, and ym_sync/ package containing __init__.py, __main__.py, cli.py, api.py, downloader.py, converter.py
